zh.title: Apollo 收購 Atlantic Aviation 主要股權，估值近 100 億美元
zh.summary: Apollo Funds 收購 Atlantic Aviation 主要股權；公司估值近 100 億美元
body: Apollo Funds 已從私募股權公司 KKR 手中購入 Atlantic Aviation 的主要股權，這筆交易使這家全球最大的固定基地營運商（FBO）網路之一的估值接近 100 億美元。
兩家公司於 2026 年 8 月 31 日宣布，KKR 在交易後仍將持有 Atlantic 的 substantial 股份，但未透露 Apollo 投資的財務條款。
據 AeroTime 報導，Atlantic 目前的規模已從 2021 年的 69 個 FBO 地點擴大到 105 個，其中逾 30 個是透過收購新增。公司為商務和私人飛機營運商提供燃油、機庫空間、飛機地勤等服務。
Atlantic 執行長 Jeff Foland 將在交易後繼續領導公司。

en.title: Apollo Funds acquires major stake in Atlantic Aviation, valuing FBO network at nearly $10 billion
en.summary: Apollo Funds buys major stake in Atlantic Aviation from KKR; valuation nears $10 billion
body: Apollo Funds has acquired a major stake in Atlantic Aviation from private equity firm KKR in a deal that values one of the world’s largest fixed-base operator (FBO) networks at nearly $10 billion, the companies announced on August 31, 2026.
KKR will remain a substantial shareholder in Atlantic following the transaction. Financial terms of Apollo’s investment were not disclosed.

Atlantic has expanded to 105 locations, more than 30 of which were added through acquisitions, according to Apollo. The company provides fuel, hangar space, aircraft handling and other services to business and private aircraft operators.
Atlantic CEO Jeff Foland will continue to lead the company following the transaction.

zh.title: 波音MH-139A灰狼直升機達初始作戰能力 守護美洲洲際飛彈
zh.summary: 美空軍全球打擊司令部宣布MH-139A達初始作戰能力，接替UH-1N執行洲際飛彈安全任務
body: 美國空軍全球打擊司令部（AFGSC）於2026年8月31日宣布，波音MH-139A「灰狼」直升機已於8月10日達到初始作戰能力（IOC），正式獲准執行洲際彈道飛彈（ICBM）安全任務。這項聲明標誌著該機型正式接替自1970年起服役的UH-1N「休伊」直升機。
「灰狼」是意大利萊昂納多公司AW139雙發商用中型直升機的軍用化衍生型。萊昂納多在位於費城東北部的工廠生產基礎機身，波音作為主承包商負責安裝軍用設備並提供交付後支援。AFGSC表示，灰狼比前代機型快近50%，載員量翻倍，並具備改進的防禦系統。
灰狼的核心任務是護送「民兵III」維修和裝甲安保車隊。第二十航空隊的責任區域約33,600平方英里（約87,000平方公里），橫跨懷俄明州弗朗西斯·沃倫空軍基地、蒙大拿州馬爾姆斯特龍空軍基地和北達科他州邁諾特空軍基地。
2026年1月8日，灰狼執行了首次實戰護送任務，第40直升機中隊的兩架飛機從馬爾姆斯特龍基地出發，護送車隊往返超過100英里（約161公里），歷時約6小時且無需空中加油。
根據波音於2026年1月29日公布的最新數據，公司已交付21架MH-139A，合同總量為38架。首架量產機於2024年8月交付。AFGSC還指出，灰狼的航程和指揮控制系統將支援向LGM-35A「哨兵」洲際彈道飛彈的過渡，後者預計於2030年代初達到初始作戰能力。此外，灰狼還將用於搜救、災害響應和醫療撤運。

en.title: Boeing MH-139A Grey Wolf reaches initial operational capability for US nuclear missile security mission
en.summary: US AFGSC declares MH-139A operational for ICBM convoy escort; replaces Huey; first convoy flown January 2026
body: The US Air Force Global Strike Command (AFGSC) announced on August 31, 2026, that the Boeing MH-139A Grey Wolf helicopter reached initial operational capability (IOC) on August 10, 2026, clearing it for the intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) security mission it was procured to perform. The declaration formalizes the handover from the UH-1N Huey, which the US Air Force has flown in missile fields since 1970.

The Grey Wolf is a militarized derivative of the Leonardo AW139 twin-engine commercial medium-lift helicopter. Leonardo produces the baseline airframe at its plant in northeast Philadelphia, and Boeing, as prime contractor, installs the military equipment and handles post-delivery support. AFGSC said the Grey Wolf is nearly 50% faster than its predecessor, carries twice as many troops, and has improved defensive systems.

The Grey Wolf’s core task is escorting Minuteman III maintenance and armored security convoys. The Twentieth Air Force area of responsibility covers approximately 33,600 square miles (about 87,000 square kilometers) of prairie, plains, and mountain terrain across F.E. Warren Air Force Base in Wyoming, Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana, and Minot Air Force Base in North Dakota.

The type flew its first operational convoy on January 8, 2026, when two aircraft from the 40th Helicopter Squadron escorted a movement more than 100 miles (over 161 kilometers) from Malmstrom and back over roughly six hours without refueling.

As of January 29, 2026, Boeing had delivered 21 MH-139As out of 38 under contract, with the first production aircraft handed over in August 2024. AFGSC also tied the helicopter to the coming transition from Minuteman III to the LGM-35A Sentinel, stating the Grey Wolf’s range and command-and-control systems are needed to secure sites through a phased transition. The Sentinel program targets its own IOC in the early 2030s. Beyond convoy escort, the Grey Wolf will also support search and rescue, disaster response, and medical evacuation.

zh.title: FAA擬對MIA Solutions處6.75萬美元民事罰款
zh.summary: FAA擬對MIA Solutions處民事罰款；涉危險品運輸違規
body: 美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）提議對佛羅里達州多拉（Doral）的MIA Solutions, LLC處以6萬7500美元的民事罰款，理由是該公司涉嫌違反美國運輸部的危險物品運輸規定。
FAA指控，MIA Solutions在2024年10月向DHL Express提供共17批內含鋰離子電池的JBL Endurance Race藍牙耳機，以空運方式運輸。鋰離子電池被列為危險物品。
FAA表示，這些貨物未隨附所需的危險物品運輸文件，且未妥善分類、描述、包裝、標示，也不符合運輸條件。此外，MIA Solutions未提供緊急應變資訊，也未對準備貨物的員工進行空中危險物品運輸培訓。
MIA Solutions在收到FAA通知後有30天時間可提出回應。

en.title: FAA Proposes $67,500 Fine Against MIA Solutions for Alleged Hazmat Violations
en.summary: FAA proposes $67,500 civil penalty against MIA Solutions over alleged hazmat shipping violations
body: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) proposes a $67,500 civil penalty against MIA Solutions, LLC of Doral, Florida, for allegedly violating U.S. Department of Transportation hazardous materials regulations.

The FAA alleges that in October 2024, MIA Solutions offered a total of 17 shipments of JBL Endurance Race Bluetooth Earbuds containing lithium-ion batteries to DHL Express for air transportation. Lithium-ion batteries are classified as a hazardous material.

The shipments were allegedly not accompanied by the required hazardous materials transportation documentation, and the materials were not properly classed, described, packaged, marked, labeled, or in proper condition for shipment. Further, MIA Solutions allegedly did not provide emergency response information and failed to properly train the employee who prepared the shipments.
MIA Solutions has 30 days after receiving the FAA's notice to respond.
